strengths.finding: The inherited cabinet composition is coherent. Native labelled fields, restrained heading steps, flat white forms and a readable dated table serve this task without introducing a new visual world.

Preview, refused write and saved window have explicit written states. The create/keep/off table precedes the one-time save, while the zero-new saved window visibly preserves alpha at 09:00 under the newer beta at 10:00 publication.

Owner detail places the original bilingual instructions and due time before the manual-result form. Completion replaces that form with rationale, actor and ledger metadata, and the interface consistently describes the result as a manual assertion.

material_findings.title: Stale-result recovery discards the retained rationale
evidence: stale-outcome-1280.jpg retains the selected status and written rationale after the stale refusal and tells the user to refresh before saving.

public/app.js:35 binds the offered refresh to fetching state and calling occurrenceDetail again. That renderer creates the status select and rationale textarea with empty values, so following the recovery action discards both unsaved fields.
material_findings.impact: The refusal initially preserves user work, but its required recovery path makes the owner re-enter or manually copy the rationale. This leaves the surface contract that stale forms preserve rationale incomplete.
material_findings.fix: Retain the unsaved status and rationale across the explicit occurrence refresh. Rehydrate them only if the refreshed occurrence is still pending, unarchived and owned by the same account, then require a new explicit submit against the fresh revision. If another result already exists or editing is no longer allowed, show the retained unsaved text separately for copying without presenting it as the saved result.
material_findings.verification: With a filled owner form, cause an unrelated global revision change, submit to receive the stale refusal, activate the offered refresh, and confirm both fields survive when the occurrence remains eligible. Confirm refresh does not write a result and the later submit is still explicit. Capture the refreshed recovery state and an already-resolved recovery case.
material_findings.resolution: The refresh callback captures the current status and rationale before fetching state. occurrenceDetail rehydrates them only in its eligible pending-owner form; otherwise it displays the retained text in a distinct read-only copy area without a result-submit control. The refreshed renderer captures the new state revision, and writing still requires a separate submit.
